slots.name: Celebrity cruise price
slots.sentence: Celebrity is offering two cruises: an 11-night Italy and Spain trip, with the eclipse falling on Day 8 (from $3,121 per person), and a seven-night Spain and Morocco journey, with the eclipse on Day 3 (from $4,883 per person).

slots.name: VACAYA cruise price
slots.sentence: And there are still a few rooms left aboard VACAYA LGBTQ+ Vacations’ 10-day eclipse cruise (from $18,963 double occupancy), which sails from Trieste, Italy, to Barcelona.

slots.name: Morocco tour price
slots.sentence: Tours of Distinction will host an 11-day Magical Morocco trip, which starts in Casablanca, stops for the eclipse in Tangier, then heads to Fez and the Sahara (from $3,999).

slots.name: National Geographic price
slots.sentence: National Geographic has a 13-day voyage that starts in the Azores, stops to witness the eclipse off the coast of Tangier and ends in Barcelona ($27,181 per person).

slots.name: Tunisia tour price
slots.sentence: Its six-day journey in Tunisia takes visitors to the setting of the desert planet Tatooine as well as “Indiana Jones” filming locations ($3,295 per person).

slots.name: Egypt tour prices
slots.sentence: A handful of openings remain on tours offered by groups like Sirius Travel, Astro-Trails and Sky & Telescope (from $2,950 to $11,680).
